annotations.text:
WHERE THE HEIGHT GOES TODAY (iPhone 15, 844 px)
Header, 2 rows: 96
Listing bar: 56
Identifier card: 130
New SKU card: ~420
Bulk add card: 70
SKU header + review banner: 100
= ~870 px before the first SKU row.
While adding a SKU, the queue is never on screen.

PROPOSED
Top strip: 44 (shop + waiting count)
Listing bar: 44 (title · 10/100 · Live pill — replaces the review banner)
New SKU: ~292 (identifier moves into the card header; prefix help → ⓘ; value-name preview sits under the field instead of its own box; Bulk add is a link)
Queue header: 44
= first SKU row at ~430 px. 4–5 SKUs visible while adding.
Save and the tabs sit at the bottom, under the thumb.

RIGHT-HAND RULE
Everything tapped repeatedly lives in the bottom-right 60% of the screen: Save, tabs, Camera, Voice, Check TikTok (↻), Sync, Export.
Top-left holds only things you read (shop, listing title, counts).
Delete = swipe a SKU row left; the × per row goes, saving 44 px of width on every row.
Sign out moves to the More tab.

ORDERS
Four date/time inputs + presets + two paragraphs (≈ 330 px) become one range chip. Tap it → the sheet on the right, with presets first.
One stats line replaces the summary card.
Listings start ~170 px from the top instead of ~700.
Cost divisor + Export are a fixed bottom bar, thumb reach, always visible.

NOTHING REMOVED, ONLY MOVED
Bulk add → link in the SKU header
Prefix change → tap the identifier
Check TikTok → ↻ on the queue header
Review state → Live / Reviewing pill in the listing bar
External variants → one expandable line under the queue
Explanatory text → ⓘ on each header
Numbers shown are today's real data. Static mockups, nothing changed in the app until you approve.

iPAD
No reach problem, so tabs go back to the top strip and the queue is a permanent right column at full height — you watch SKUs land while adding the next one.
Same components as the phone, so one codebase.
